announcements.text: L3 Technologies Inc., Chesapeake Sciences Division, Millersville, Maryland, is awarded a $42,677,977 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract containing cost-plus-fixed-fee, firm-fixed-price, and cost only provisions. This contract is for hardware and services required to support towed array programs using towed array integrated product team telemetry. Work will be performed in Millersville, Maryland, and the ordering period will be completed in July 2031. Service cost center funds in the amount of $171,010 will be obligated at the first delivery order to satisfy the minimum guarantee and will not expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was not competitively procured under the authority of 10 U.S. Code 2304(c)(5) as implemented by Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-5: authorized or required by Statute and authorized by 15 U.S. Code 638(r)(1). Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport, Newport, Rhode Island, is the contracting activity (N66604-26-D-P600).
